subject: Errors while runing DEB model tutorial with Sceloporus occidentalis

messages.author: 7b9976a7166ab661
messages.subject: Errors while runing DEB model tutorial with Sceloporus occidentalis
parts:
Hi everyone, thanks in advance for your attention.

I have run the tutorial script about the ecotherm model of Eulamprus quoyii with the deb activated and it runs adequately. However, I am trying to run it for Sceloporus occidentalis (which is in the allStat database). For that, I have reemplaced some parameters with values according to the reported biology of S. occidentalis (I annotate the source from where I got the new values). The problem is that the table yearout indicates that the lizard population has gone extinct with extreme values of R0=0 and r=0, maybe because the table yearsout indicates that the simulated animal died the first year of simulation (n= 5 years). 

Even if a do not replace any value at all, except the species (S. occidentalis instead of E. quoyii) I get the same issue. However, if I replace E. quoyii with Sceloporus undulatus, the problem disappears and everything runs fine again.

Maybe there is an issue with the parameters of S. occidentalis in the allStat database or there is a problem of garbage in garbage out, but I don't know where the garbage is.

Please, I hope you can help me.
Best regards.

Hi Israel,

I am away on leave at the moment so can't look into this right now but try looking at the output closely to see what might be going wrong, especially the plot of the wet mass from the debout table. Re the behaviour when you replace the species name, it is possibly because a variable (may be the thermal response parameters e.g. T_AH, T_AL, T_L or T_H) that has not been estimated but is being assumed because it's missing is responsible (the ifexists lines in the code you sent).

All the best,
Mike
